# seller-key-tiebreak

The original, a copy at 9 days (out of the original's reach, alone) and one at 4.5 days that reaches both. Without keys it would join the original (gap 3.8 days against 4.5); it shares a seller token with the 9-day copy, from the same run, so the key breaks the tie and they form a group, the earlier (9100000000000003) as origin. The original stands alone.
